# Relative Strength Index

*Relative strength index with 70/30 bands.*

**Kind** indicator · **Drawn** in its own pane

## Try it

On the chart, press <kbd>/</kbd> and choose **Relative Strength Index** under **Oscillators**. To change it, copy the source below into the AlphaScript editor.

## Inputs

| Input | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| RSI length | int | `14` |
| Source | source | `"close"` |
| Upper band | int | `70` |
| Lower band | int | `30` |
| Color | color | `"#7E57C2"` |
| Background | color | `"rgba(126,87,194,0.1)"` |

## Source

From `packages/alphascript/indicators/rsi.as.js`.

```js
indicator({ name: "Relative Strength Index", shortTitle: "RSI", overlay: false, precision: 2, titleInputs: ["RSI length", "Source"] });
const length = input.int("RSI length", 14, { min: 1 });
const src = input.source("Source", "close");
const upperBand = input.int("Upper band", 70, { group: "Bands" }), lowerBand = input.int("Lower band", 30, { group: "Bands" });
plot(ta.rsi(src, length), { title: "RSI", color: input.color("Color", "#7E57C2", { group: "Style" }) });
hline(upperBand, { title: "Upper band", color: "#787B86", style: "dashed" });
hline(50, { title: "Middle band", color: "rgba(120,123,134,0.5)", style: "dotted" });
hline(lowerBand, { title: "Lower band", color: "#787B86", style: "dashed" });
fill(upperBand, lowerBand, { title: "Background", color: input.color("Background", "rgba(126,87,194,0.1)", { group: "Style" }) });
```
